name: Environmental Monitoring — Historical Water Quality Explorer
scope: Surface row (0.0 m) only from annex Tables 4–7; no other depths or tables are incorporated.

stations.E1: Station 1 near the outlet, as described in the thesis
stations.E2: Station 2 in the central region, as described in the thesis

source.author: Esperanza Hernández Piedrahíta
source.title: Caracterização limnológica e estudo do processo de sedimentação e liberação de fósforo da Lagoa do Taquaral - Campinas (SP)

review.method: Each of the 48 selected surface cells was visually compared against the rendered original table row, including date/station column headings and unit. Printed decimal commas are preserved in value_raw and normalized to decimal points in value.
review.reviewer: AI-assisted transcription; not an independent second review

limitations: Selected surface observations only; the complete depth profiles remain untranscribed and unreviewed.
No station coordinates are inferred; station descriptions do not establish surveyed positions.
Blank cells elsewhere in the source are not converted to zero or filled. No missing values are introduced or inferred in the selected complete surface rows.
No current-condition statement, regulatory classification, trend forecast or safety assessment is produced.
The chart displays discrete observations without interpolation between campaigns.
The original measurements have not been independently revalidated; visual transcription checks do not establish instrument accuracy.
